Hero_Desc_Sherum:
Belitein's historian and the court scribe.
She possesses a thorough professionalism that allows for absolutely no exceptions in her records.
Her vast and detailed knowledge of Elias's history may someday play a significant role.
Album_Wish_Sherum: Rewriting the history of the Witch Kingdom.
Album_Sherum1: Among the many retainers in the Witch Court, Sherum stands out the most. She follows Belita and the court witches, meticulously documenting their every move.
Album_Sherum2: Fricle considers Sherum a major nuisance. The fact that Sherum records every embarrassing moment—without fail—constantly angers her. However, Sherum remains indifferent and continues to calmly record everything she sees, even Fricle's furious outbursts.
Album_Sherum3: Even outside the court, Sherum never stops taking notes. She records everything happening in front of her and will tenaciously follow a subject, documenting their every action. Some Apostles appreciate it, while others find it annoying... and of course, I am no exception.
Album_Sherum4: Erpin is absolutely terrified of Sherum. Apparently, Ner has used Sherum's records multiple times to expose Erpin's laziness. I once joined Ner in scolding Erpin—only to suddenly find myself included in Sherum's records and getting scolded too.
Album_Sherum5: Belita, on the other hand, praises Sherum's unwavering dedication. While she admits there are things she'd rather keep hidden, she also believes that selectively erasing information would make Sherum's work meaningless. It seems Sherum deeply respects Belita for this.
Album_Sherum6: One day, Sherum followed me around the Order, taking notes, which made me a bit uncomfortable. But later, those very notes ended up saving me—when I was about to be falsely accused of stealing Erpin's cake, Sherum's records provided an airtight alibi.
Album_Sherum7: Sherum once told me that recording my actions is particularly interesting. Until now, I had thought I was just going about my duties in the Order without much thought, but after looking at the records of my own activities, I couldn't help but feel a little proud of myself.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Sherum: I will document the flow of Elias.
Sherum_Spawn1: Now, let's start recording, thoroughly with no exceptions!
Sherum_Spawn2-01: Record: The scribe enters battle in response to the Master's summons.
Sherum_Spawn2: Summoned by the Master, the scribe joins the battle...
Sherum_Growth: I am Sherum, scribe of the Witch Kingdom.
Sherum_Growth1: See, more records are piling up every day!
Sherum_Growth2: The scribe has grown further. Her future bears watching.
Sherum_Victory1: History belongs to the winner, they say?
Sherum_Victory2: The Master won... Seems to be a fitting leader...
Sherum_Defeat1: I can't make an exception in my records just because you lost.
Sherum_Defeat2: The Master lost... There seems to be a lack in leadership...
Sherum_Affinity1_1: The insurgency against the Sprite Queen? That was just a childish prank.
Sherum_Affinity1_2: A hungry cat werebeast approaches a dog werebeast. It seems she's after her chow.
Sherum_Affinity2: Write this, and don't write that? There is no consistency. I'll just write down all.
Sherum_Affinity1_3: What an impressive memory! That really helps with my records!
Sherum_Affinity3: A phrase I never recorded...? Could someone have tampered with it?
Sherum_Affinity4: On a sunny day, three werebeast roughnecks attacked the Order Banquet Hall... After the Queen stole the cake, she falsely claimed that it was stolen by these werebeasts...
Sherum_Affinity5: Queen Belita always moves so gracefully. Except during meals.
Sherum_Affinity6: The elves' electronic record book... Should I get one? I just hope it doesn't have any listening devices.
Sherum_Affinity7: Just documenting your actions is entertaining. I'll keep following you closely.
Sherum_Die2: The opponent's brutal attack... forces the scribe to retire...
Sherum_LevelUp: You see as much as you know. You can record as much as you experience.
Sherum_Equipment: Thanks for the good gear, but my writing won't be just in your favor, okay?
Sherum_HeroSkill: I think the basics are more important than the tricks, but... it's good!
Sherum_HeroUpgrade: The scribe has been promoted... it doesn't seem to benefit her in any way...
Sherum_Board: What do you think will happen over there?
Sherum_DeckSetting1: I will write the records thoroughly from nearby.
Sherum_DeckSetting2: A perfect place to record history...! Just what I was hoping for.
Sherum_Stage: Another piece of history will be written.
Sherum_Touch1: My cheeks were pulled again. Just why?
Sherum_Touch1_1: The Master pulled my cheeks again today.
Sherum_Touch2_1: The Master petted my head again. It's a little embarrassing to record.
Sherum_Touch1_2: Why didn't I record it? I forgot because I'm so used to it.
Sherum_Touch2: The Master petted my head. I'm very baffled.
Sherum_Touch2_2: The Master petted my head again... Please don't be mean.
Sherum_DutchRubEnd2: I-I'm going to write all of this down, too!
Sherum_Growth1_Skin1: It feels as though a sweet melody is ringing out.
Sherum_Growth2_Skin1: It is a masterpiece precisely because it is a classic.
Sherum_LevelUp_Skin1: Just a little more and I will be world-class...!

Sherum_Touch2_1_Skin1: Oh~ A melody... is beginning to come to me...!
Sherum_Touch2_2_Skin1: Mi, re, do, re, mi, mi, mi~
Sherum_Growth1_Skin2: I think I shall put away my pen and focus on this moment today.
Sherum_Growth2_Skin2: Shall we take a photograph instead of recording it with a pen?
Sherum_LevelUp_Skin2: I am perfectly prepared for our outing!
Sherum_Equipment_Skin2: Wow, I should try wearing this next time!
Sherum_HeroSkill_Skin2: Experiencing it firsthand is not so bad.
Sherum_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Shall we make a flower crown from these flowers?
Sherum_Board_Skin2: Is there a flower garden over there?
Sherum_Touch1_Skin2: Where did I put my pen...?
Sherum_Touch1_1_Skin2: I will not record this, but I will remember it.
Sherum_Touch1_2_Skin2: How about paying a little more attention to our outing?
Sherum_Touch2_Skin2: It is embarrassing, but not unpleasant.
Sherum_Touch2_1_Skin2: You are praising me because today is special, right?
Sherum_Touch2_2_Skin2: I like how your touch is as warm as the weather.
Sherum_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Did you really have to do this today of all days?
Sherum_Growth1_Skin3: I am Belladonna, the greatest novelist of all.
Sherum_Growth2_Skin3: The noble me has arrived in this humble place. Please welcome me.
Sherum_LevelUp_Skin3: Good writing springs from a fine imagination.
Sherum_Equipment_Skin3: Excellent! The Four Treasures of the Study are complete.
Sherum_HeroSkill_Skin3: My thanks. My writing has improved considerably.
Sherum_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: Hehe, my writing has improved by leaps and bounds.
Sherum_Board_Skin3: I wonder if there is any interesting material around?
Sherum_Touch1_Skin3: Why must you behave with such savagery?
Sherum_Touch1_2_Skin3: I have decided to accept this as an expression of affection.
Sherum_Touch2_Skin3: Hmm~ I feel inspiration surging forth!
Sherum_Touch2_1_Skin3: I am considering a romance novel for my next work. What think you?
Sherum_Touch2_2_Skin3: Truth be told, your touch pleased me greatly.
Sherum_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: You are utterly ignorant and foolish beyond measure!
Sherum_AsideGet: Oh my goodness... all of history is recorded in it!
Sherum_AsideUpgrade: Now I can leave even more complete records.
Sherum_SPSkill1: These records have accompanied the history of witches.
Sherum_SPSkill1-01: These records have accompanied the history of witches.
Sherum_SPSkill1-02: These records have accompanied the history of witches.
Sherum_Ultimate1: Even if you try to avoid it, you must face it eventually.
Sherum_Ultimate1-01: Even if you try to avoid it, you must face it eventually.
Sherum_BasicAttack1: I will not let you escape.
Sherum_BasicAttack1-01: I will not let you escape.
Sherum_Shout5: I am going to write it all down.
Sherum_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master. Why are you surprised? As a scribe, I would never overlook such an important date.
Sherum_Gacha2: I will document the flow of Elias.
Sherum_Gacha3: History is the flow of events, passing beside us with the course of time.
Sherum_Greeting: It is a pleasure to meet you.
Sherum_Line1: Why does everyone dislike history? It is the best-crafted story in the world.
Sherum_Line2: Record: A witch's adjutant instructed the scribe not to record that she had instructed the scribe not to record it.
Sherum_Line3: You are curious about me rather than my records? You truly are unusual.
Sherum_Lobby: Is there anything worth recording around here?
Sherum_StartJourney1: Another piece of history is being recorded.
Sherum_StartJourney2: I wonder if there is anything worth recording.
Sherum_StartJourney3: I wonder what will happen over there.
LoveLetter_Sherum:
Greetings, Master.

Have you been in good health? Letters are not a kind of document I write often, so please forgive me if my language appears somewhat stiff.

I am always grateful that, like Queen Belita, you extend such generous understanding toward my profession. As a scribe, I will devote myself wholeheartedly to any task through which I may assist you. So please do not feel burdened, and treat me comfortably. I shall end here.

Respectfully,
Sherum
LoveCall_Sherum:
Hello, Master.
Hmm... Speaking over the phone like this feels rather awkward.
Still, I am glad that it allows me to check on you despite how busy you are.

I was wondering whether I might write your memoirs, Master.
A considerable time has passed since you came to Elias...
And your influence, not only upon me but upon everyone in Elias, has been profound.
I absolutely do not wish to write this memoir solely for personal reasons! Please do not misunderstand!

A-Anyway, if you agree, I would like to stay together with you for several days and devote that time to writing.
As an appendix, I intend to separately classify the events that occurred between you and me.
O-Of course, I could not record every excessively private matter!

Ah, I am growing warm. I shall end the call here.
I will contact you again. I would appreciate your answer about the memoir after you have considered it.
Affinity_Sherum_EP01_001: The archives contain many interesting records about you, Master. One day, I should cross-check them...
Affinity_Sherum_EP01_002: Indeed. Epica worked hard to write them down.
Affinity_Sherum_EP01_003: What? The novelist was the archivist? Hmm... That significantly reduces their credibility.
Affinity_Sherum_EP01_005: Hmm? The Dragon with glasses? Thanks to her, many records that nearly vanished from the Witch Library were restored.
Affinity_Sherum_EP01_006: Which records? You did not read a book written by Mayo, did you?
Affinity_Sherum_EP01_007: Do you mean the book filled with astonishing detail about you, Master? It is an extremely valuable historical source.
Affinity_Sherum_EP02_001: Is my name... truly that difficult to read? Some people cannot pronounce it correctly.
Affinity_Sherum_EP02_003: ...Are you truly going to call me that? Have you confused me with someone else?
Affinity_Sherum_EP02_005: Exactly! I knew you would pronounce it correctly on your first attempt, Master!
Affinity_Sherum_EP02_006: It is not difficult at all. Who cannot pronounce it?
Affinity_Sherum_EP02_007: The Sprite Queen. She keeps calling me 'Red Pen Teacher' instead of using my name.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_001: History cannot be changed, yet sometimes I wonder what an untaken path would have been like if I returned to the past.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_002: Imagining it alone is entertaining. I daydream about such things occasionally too.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_003: Exactly. Such imagination enriches our thoughts.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_004: Traveling back through time to alter events is dangerous.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_005: The part-time worker at the theater said something similar. How interesting.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_006: There are no proper records anyway, so rewrite it into something entertaining.
Affinity_Sherum_EP03_007: Master! How could you say that? Do you not understand the value of history?
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_001: I believe I should conduct a one-on-one interview with you sometime, Master. There are matters I wish to verify.
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_002: Ah, receiving such a request so suddenly is a little embarrassing...!
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_003: H-hmm? What do you mean? That was not the response I expected...
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_004: What sort of interview? What do you want to ask?
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_005: Who is your favorite Apostle, Master? I shall keep it off the record, so please answer.
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_006: Ask me anytime. I shall answer diligently.
Affinity_Sherum_EP04_007: You are a person with no secrets and a clean conscience. That makes you exceptionally agreeable to me.
Affinity_Sherum_EP05_001: Does the Sprite Kingdom have no history books? Comparing them with Witch histories could yield fascinating results...
Affinity_Sherum_EP05_002: Does it look as though they would have such a thing?
Affinity_Sherum_EP05_003: What? Uh... They do not? Why? Why not? How could this be...?
Affinity_Sherum_EP05_005: That is... a history book? Ah... I do not mean to criticize it, but still... Hmm...
Affinity_Sherum_EP05_006: Perhaps Ashur wrote such a book.
Affinity_Sherum_EP05_007: Hmm, the Sprite who authored that remarkable guide to solving magical problems? I must meet her.
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_001: What sort of history do the Elves possess? Would they answer if I asked?
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_002: They would answer if there were some profit in it for them.
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_003: Would they demand a sort of 'gift'? Hmm, what might they like?
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_004: Elves are a race declining in grief!
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_005: What? Judging by their usual behavior, they do not particularly look that way...
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_006: Be certain to ask them about Christmas when you meet.
Affinity_Sherum_EP06_007: Christmas? Is that a word deeply connected to them? Understood. I shall ask immediately after greeting them.
Affinity_Sherum_EP07_001: I wonder what Elias was like before its history was recorded. What secrets might be hidden there?
Affinity_Sherum_EP07_002: Perhaps many are hidden beneath the Order?
Affinity_Sherum_EP07_003: Underground? What lies beneath the Order? They would not even allow me to enter.
Affinity_Sherum_EP07_004: The Beastfolk may know a great deal.
Affinity_Sherum_EP07_005: The folktales passed down orally? I agree. Meanings lie hidden within their disorder.
Affinity_Sherum_EP07_006: Why not create that history now? Let us burn the books!
Affinity_Sherum_EP08_001: I would like to take charge of writing your autobiography, Master.
Affinity_Sherum_EP08_003: It is fine. It will be compiled after you have departed, so you will no longer be able to feel embarrassed.
Affinity_Sherum_EP08_005: How could you say that? Everything on it is important source material!
Affinity_Sherum_EP08_006: I was considering entrusting it to someone other than you...
Affinity_Sherum_EP08_007: What? To whom? A poet? A collector? A stalker?
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_001: Queen Belita became angry with me recently. Should I make my records a little less exacting sometimes?
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_002: What did you write that made her angry?
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_003: I wrote that she attached her younger sister's photograph to a doll and embraced it while sleeping.
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_004: Please be less exacting! Your records have caused trouble for me too!
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_005: It is hardly my fault that your record of skipping work leaked and the High Priest scolded you!
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_006: It happened because everyone was working hard. Keep doing what you have been doing!
Affinity_Sherum_EP09_007: You understand me? How moving. I shall record this moment.
Affinity_Sherum_EP10_001: Even ten bodies would not be enough. Whom should I follow to record historic moments?
Affinity_Sherum_EP10_003: Our wise queen is certainly the ideal choice. Though it is troublesome when she occasionally disappears somewhere...
Affinity_Sherum_EP10_005: The Sprite Queen? Truly? Are you serious? Please answer me.
Affinity_Sherum_EP10_007: Hmm, that sounded like a joke, but it is actually a plausible answer. ...What? You were not joking?
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_001: I can feel the atmosphere of history in the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_002: It has not been long since I renovated the place.
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_003: Then that atmosphere must come from the dust accumulated in the corners. Why not clean it?
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_004: Perhaps it is because I collected furniture from all over.
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_005: V-vintage is a new form of beauty. You are very frugal, Master.
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_006: I am creating the history of Elias cuisine.
Affinity_Sherum_EP11_007: Being Master of the Order was not your primary occupation? Still, culinary history is a fascinating field.
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_001: Ah, I confused the fork with my quill. No wonder.
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_002: Did you spear your food with the quill?
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_003: Something pricked my tongue, and when I looked, it was the quill. How foolish of me.
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_004: Did you write with the fork?
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_005: Each stroke left three lines, so I wondered whether something was wrong with my eyes. I have ruined one fork. My apologies.
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_006: You already have a habit of sucking on your quill.
Affinity_Sherum_EP12_007: Wh-when did you see that? I do it only very occasionally! It is not a frequent habit!
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_001: The records of ordinary people become the foundation of great history.
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_002: I think we can omit Marie's bomb recipes.
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_003: Why? They are essential for tracing the development of tools across different eras.
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_004: I think we can omit Festa's lyric notebook.
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_005: It does seem somewhat useless. It was closer to a ledger of busking proceeds.
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_006: I think we can omit Renewa's theater sales records.
Affinity_Sherum_EP13_007: Those are precious records that reveal the degree of cultural participation. Honestly, Master.
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_001: The Elves look surprised whenever they see me carrying a paper record book. Why might that be?
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_002: Monatium uses electronic tablets rather than paper.
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_003: I am uncertain whether a medium that can erase every record with one mistake is truly advanced.
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_004: They rarely have occasion to see witches.
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_005: That is probably true. We would be surprised if an Elf appeared in Velitien too.
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_006: They are surprised because you are so adorable.
Affinity_Sherum_EP14_007: S-saying that will not persuade me to erase the record of you spilling cream everywhere while eating bread.
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_001: What history does the food I ate today possess?
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_002: This salt carries a sorrowful legend.
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_003: A legend? You use something so precious merely to make food salty?!
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_004: Shall I tell you the history of its price increases?
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_005: The price increased and it is still free? Did you once give guests both food and money? I arrived far too late.
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_006: Is it not exhausting to assign meaning to everything?
Affinity_Sherum_EP15_007: Perhaps, but everything truly contains a record. I am merely its discoverer.
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_001: I wish everyone felt closer to historical records. What method might work?
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_002: Whisper them continuously into people's ears while they sleep.
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_003: Not every record is peaceful. I worry they may have nightmares.
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_004: Why not turn the records into videos?
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_005: I considered it, but the subjects frequently refuse to appear. They say too many records violate their privacy.
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_006: A mandatory reading group is best.
Affinity_Sherum_EP16_007: Then only those unable to sleep would attend. Forcing people to read is not the answer.
Affinity_Sherum_EP17_001: A chronicler requires concentration, observation, and physical strength.
Affinity_Sherum_EP17_003: One must not miss a single instant to create a nearly perfect record. For example, the moment Fricle slips on a potato chip bag.
Affinity_Sherum_EP17_005: Careful observation reveals details others miss. Such as Her Majesty placing chocolate between carrot sticks before eating them.
Affinity_Sherum_EP17_007: Strong legs are essential to prevent others from taking my records. I am merely honest, yet everyone chases me with fire in their eyes.
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_001: It is not that I cannot fight. I simply chose a different style of combat.
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_002: Just admit that you cannot fight.
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_003: Must you strike precisely where it hurts? How coldhearted.
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_004: The one who makes the other person angrier wins.
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_005: Then I am always on the winning side. Still, that feels slightly bitter.
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_006: Do you believe the pen is mightier than the sword?
Affinity_Sherum_EP18_007: Believing so offers comfort. I am not especially skilled at wielding a sword.
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_001: What sort of record would you like to leave behind, Master?
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_002: I hope everyone records me favorably.
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_003: Then you must continue striving to be a good person, though you are already one.
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_004: I would rather leave no record and be forgotten quickly.
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_005: That would be far too sad. I shall not erase your records, Master.
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_006: I want an unremarkable record in which every day is peaceful.
Affinity_Sherum_EP19_007: 'Today was another good day' is a wonderful closing line. I hope today is another good day for you.
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_001: Uuugh... My arm hurts terribly after writing all day.
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_002: Is that an excuse for spilling your food?
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_003: I-I did spill a little, but you need not reprimand me so harshly.
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_004: I shall massage your arm. Give it to me.
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_005: Like this? ...This is as far as I can extend it.
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_006: Now you want me to feed you? There is no dessert.
Affinity_Sherum_EP20_007: I still have enough arm strength to eat dessert... Did you truly prepare none?
